turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to track down why the CI pipeline is failing on the latest commit. It looks like a timeout issue.
I can help with that. Have you checked the build logs for specific steps that are taking longer than usual?
Yes, it's stuck on the dependency installation. Also, while I'm here, don't forget to link this bug report to the Per-User Memory Architecture task. It's currently Backlog item #45.
Understood. I've noted that the Per-User Memory Architecture is linked to Backlog item #45. I'll check if the dependency installation timeout is related to the network configuration.
Thanks. Also, what's the weather like for this weekend? I'm thinking of going hiking.
It's looking partly cloudy with a high of 72°F, which should be nice for hiking. No rain expected.
Great choice. Let me know if you need any gear recommendations.
Lloyd, I need to update the sprint board. We moved the Per-User Memory Architecture work. It's no longer #45; it's actually Backlog item #91 now.
Got it. I've updated my records to reflect that Per-User Memory Architecture is now tracked as Backlog item #91.
Good. By the way, did that new monitor stand ever arrive? I need it for the meeting tomorrow.
The tracking number shows it was delivered yesterday, but it might still be in the mailroom. I can send you a photo of the mailroom inventory if you'd like.
No, I'll just go check. Oh, and can you cancel my 2 PM appointment? I have to prep for the demo.
Done. Your 2 PM appointment has been cancelled. Good luck with the demo prep.
